model_annotation:
The chart compares the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four sectors: Industry, Construction, Trade, and Other Services in 2021. 
There are three doughnut charts representing the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover, each divided into four sectors. 
The "Number of Enterprises" chart has four sectors: Other Services (blue, 61%, 19.0 min), Trade (red, 19%, 5.9 min), Construction (yellow, 12%, 3.7 min), and Industry (dark blue, 8%, 2.4 min). 
The "Number of Persons Employed" chart also has four sectors: Other Services (blue, 51%, 80.2 mln), Industry (dark blue, 21%, 33.0 mln), Trade (red, 19%, 29.5 mln), and Construction (yellow, 9%, 13.4 mln). 
The "Turnover" chart has four sectors: Industry (dark blue, 33%, 10.6 trillion), Other Services and Trade (both 31%, 9.8 trillion and 9.9 trillion respectively), and Construction (yellow, 6%, 1.9 trillion). 
All three charts share a common legend, which is presented below the charts and indicates the color associated with each sector. 
The sectors in the charts are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top, with the largest sector at the top in the "Number of Enterprises" and "Number of Persons Employed" charts, but not in the "Turnover" chart, where Industry and Other Services are almost equal.
